title: Test Run Event
description: The canonical record of a single test execution run. Every project in the AI-QA portfolio either produces or consumes this document. Producers are test harnesses; consumers are triage, risk-selection, and analytics services.

schemaVersion.description: Semver of this contract. Consumers MUST reject majors they do not understand.

runId.description: Globally unique id for this run. Stable primary key across all downstream stores.

trigger.description: What caused this run. Distinguishes human-initiated runs from CI and from agent-initiated exploration.

dirty.description: True if the working tree had uncommitted changes. A dirty run is not reproducible; consumers should weight it accordingly.

runnerVersion.description: Version of the test runner, e.g. the Playwright version.

injection.description: Which faults were deliberately enabled for this run. This is what makes a run self-describing: months later you can reconstruct exactly what was wrong with the system under test. Real-world producers emit empty arrays here.

defects.description: Defect ids from defects.json that were active.

flakes.description: Flake id to trigger probability (0..1) for this run.

seed.description: PRNG seed used for flake injection. Same seed plus same flake config reproduces the same run.

flaky.description: Tests that failed at least once then passed on retry.

testId.description: Stable hash of file + full title path. MUST NOT change between runs when the test is untouched — downstream history correlation depends on it.

file.description: Repo-relative POSIX path. Normalised so Windows and Linux runs correlate.

flaky.description: True when the test failed at least once and then passed within its retry budget.

error.description: Present only for non-passing results. The fields here are the raw material for clustering and classification.

snippet.description: Source excerpt around the failure point.

locator.description: The selector involved, when the failure was a locator failure. Consumed directly by the self-healing-locator project.

signature.description: Normalised, de-parameterised form of the error message. Numbers, uuids, timestamps and paths are replaced with placeholders so identical root causes collide into one cluster key.

artifacts.description: Paths relative to the run's artifact directory.

dom.description: Serialised DOM captured at failure. Required input for locator healing.

groundTruth.description: OPTIONAL and non-authoritative. Populated only by the proving ground, which knows which faults it injected. Real producers omit this. Downstream classifiers MUST NOT read it at inference time — it exists solely to score them afterwards.
